left_ventricle.name: Left Ventricle
left_ventricle.function: Pumps oxygenated blood to the entire body.

right_ventricle.name: Right Ventricle
right_ventricle.function: Pumps deoxygenated blood to the lungs.

left_atrium.name: Left Atrium
left_atrium.function: Receives oxygenated blood from the lungs.

right_atrium.name: Right Atrium
right_atrium.function: Receives deoxygenated blood from the body.

aorta.name: Aorta
aorta.function: Main artery carrying blood from the heart to the body.

pulmonary_artery.name: Pulmonary Artery
pulmonary_artery.function: Carries deoxygenated blood to the lungs.

mitral_valve.name: Mitral Valve
mitral_valve.function: Regulates flow from left atrium to left ventricle.

tricuspid_valve.name: Tricuspid Valve
tricuspid_valve.function: Regulates flow from right atrium to right ventricle.

aortic_valve.name: Aortic Valve
aortic_valve.function: Regulates flow from left ventricle to aorta.

pulmonary_valve.name: Pulmonary Valve
pulmonary_valve.function: Regulates flow from right ventricle to pulmonary artery.

coronary_arteries.name: Coronary Arteries
coronary_arteries.function: Supplies oxygenated blood to the heart muscle itself.

left_ventricular_hypertrophy.name: Left Ventricular Hypertrophy
left_ventricular_hypertrophy.description: Thickening of the muscular wall of the left ventricle, often due to high blood pressure.

myocardial_infarction.name: Myocardial Infarction
myocardial_infarction.description: Death of heart muscle due to lack of blood supply.

coronary_artery_disease.name: Coronary Artery Disease
coronary_artery_disease.description: Damage or disease in the heart's major blood vessels.

aortic_stenosis.name: Aortic Stenosis
aortic_stenosis.description: Narrowing of the aortic valve opening.

mitral_regurgitation.name: Mitral Regurgitation
mitral_regurgitation.description: The mitral valve does not close tightly, allowing blood to flow backward.
